BCWD Fee Reimbursement - Eligibility
Caste Students belonging to OBC category ONLY
Family annual income <= Rs. 2.5 lakhs for Category 1 students and < =1 lakhs for other categories
Course Type All
College Type All except evening college and KSOU admitted students
College Seat Type Excluding students admitted through Management, ComedK, Pvt seat in Pvt college, Students in KSOU and Evening colleges
Promotion status Promoted to present year
Pass in All Subjects in previous year Must be passed in all subjects of previous year
